newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht slides late, interbank steady - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht slides late, interbank steady - dealers.

text.p: The Thai baht fell sharply late on Monday as players especially offshore banks in Singapore heavily sold the currency for dollars to cover short positions ahead of the year-end, dealers said.

Dealers said they had heard of the Bank of Thailand's intervention in the Singapore market by increasing the dollar supply in the market at lower than market offered rates to curb the baht's sharp decline.
The baht was quoted at 25.612-25.615 to the dollar in late trade after being dealt at as low as around 25.620 in early afternoon trade.
